## Continuity start state

Start from Book Two Text Lock and latest accepted series continuity records, not summaries alone. Carry every explicit state field and open thread into a machine-readable ledger. Known Book Two final state includes Mriya’s authority limitation; Bond 0; Supply 11 without guaranteed supply; disputed/unspent Favor; Hearth’s limited district choices; Rook’s defense debt; Sable/High Collars/Free Teeth and municipal/Subsurface threads unresolved; Custodian 0.03 observation only. Verify exact phrasing against Book Two continuity QA before drafting. Do not silently resolve an open thread in production metadata.

## Art / brand canon

- Language channels: DOG dialogue → Pictiq only from owner-approved Composer output; HUMAN direct speech → English; System → established System typography/English.
- Exact speaker attribution and dialogue source are locked to Text Lock; artwork cannot invent, translate, or reassign lines.
- Keep source images immutable; print derivatives deterministic and separately hashed; Kindle uses approved original assets unless a documented technical exception is approved.
- Book Two program is two owner-accepted atmospheric silent cinematic images plus four comics, with owner-approved exceptions for opening/closing literal scene match, C02 panel count, and retrospective Pictiq semantics. These are Book Two exceptions, not automatic Book Three permissions.
- Series cover guidance: retain established Book One hierarchy and thumbnail identity. Book Two has an approved cover brief, but a second final cover is not evidenced in the records inspected; therefore treat cross-book visual conclusions as provisional until actual covers are compared. Do not start an open-ended branding exercise.

## Non-inherited / must not be invented

No Book Three title, chapter count, word count, scene list, illustration count, Composer dialogue, cover accent color, ISBN, print page count, final price, release date, AI disclosure submission state, or live KDP status is known. Owner approval is required when the field affects story, public metadata, retailer release, or a deviation from production defaults.

## Evidence vocabulary

`RECOVERED` = directly present in source evidence; `IMPLIED_BY_BOOK_ONE` = necessary implication from locked Book One; `NEW_INFERENCE` = new Book Three creative proposal, unaccepted until Gate A and later textual lock. Production status values distinguish `LOCAL_QA_PASS`, `KDP_PREVIEW_PASS`, `SUBMITTED`, `IN_REVIEW`, `PUBLISHING`, and `LIVE`.
